audience: charity teams that run fundraisers and events on BetterNow

useCases.title: Review fundraisers and their donations
useCases.text: List the fundraising pages of your charity, then read one page and its donations. Donor details are not shown.

useCases.title: See a charity's projects and donations
useCases.text: Read the charity, its projects and the donations it received. Only public donation fields are shown.

useCases.title: Review an event and its teams
useCases.text: Read an event with its links, then list the fundraising teams with their goals and captains.

useCases.title: Create a fundraising page
useCases.text: Create a public fundraising page for a person under a project and a site.

useCases.title: Create a team or add a page to a team
useCases.text: Create a public team under an event and a site, or add a fundraising page to a team as a member.
